subject: DI04000241

body.en:
Start with the situation

A small flat block and a very large machine bed both need plane surfaces, but moving their mass requires different arrangements.

Definition / principle

A shaper reciprocates a single-point tool over comparatively stationary work; a planer reciprocates the work past toolheads.

Understand why

The cutting stroke removes material; the return stroke is usually idle. Feed increments expose the next strip.

Application / illustration

Shaping suits suitable small flat/angular surfaces; planing accommodates larger/heavier jobs within machine capacity.

Common mistake / conditions

The syllabus says planning; the manufacturing-process term is planing, not production planning.

Does return motion mean the machine is safe to approach?

No. Return is still hazardous powered motion.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Small flat block અને large machine bed બન્નેમાં plane surfaces જોઈએ,પણ mass ખસેડવાની arrangement જુદી છે.

Definition / Principle

Shaperમાં single-point tool work ઉપર reciprocate થાય;planerમાં work toolheads પાસેથી reciprocate થાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Cutting stroke material દૂર કરે;return સામાન્ય રીતે idle.Feed incrementથી next strip મળે.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Shaping suitable small flat/angular surfaces;planing capacityમાં larger/heavier jobs માટે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Syllabusમાં planning લખ્યું છે;અહીં processનું નામ planing છે,production planning નહિ.

Return Motionમાં Machine પાસે જવું Safe છે?

ના.Return પણ hazardous powered motion છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A rigid column guides a reciprocating ram carrying the cutting tool.

Construction:part and purpose

Base and column support the drive and ram guideways.

Ram provides the principal reciprocating tool motion.

Toolhead includes vertical adjustment and angular setting for suitable surfaces.

A clapper arrangement permits tool relief on the idle return in the appropriate setup.

Crossrail, saddle and table support the vice or fixture.

Crank/quick-return drive provides stroke motion; feed drive increments the table.

Vice, guards, lubrication, travel limits and controls complete the working system.

Working:flow and reason

Locate and clamp work with the cutting path and overtravel clear.

Under the approved method, set stroke length/position to cover the feature.

The drive converts motor rotation into ram reciprocation.

Tool engagement during the cutting stroke removes a strip of material.

The return is usually quicker and idle; tool relief avoids dragging when correctly arranged.

Incremental table feed presents the next strip between appropriate strokes.

Safe stop permits inspection of flatness, size and finish before adjustments.

Common mistake / conditions

Keep hands and obstacles outside the entire ram/table travel; automatic return is still hazardous motion.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Rigid column cutting toolવાળા reciprocating ramને guide કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Base,column drive,ram guideways support કરે.

Ram principal reciprocating tool motion આપે.

Toolheadમાં vertical adjustment,angular setting હોય.

Appropriate setupમાં clapper return પર tool relief આપે.

Crossrail,saddle,table vice/fixture support કરે.

Crank/quick-return drive stroke આપે;feed drive tableને increment આપે.

Vice,guards,lubrication,travel limits,controls system પૂર્ણ કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Cutting path,overtravel clear રાખી work locate/clamp કરો.

Approved methodથી featureને આવરે તે stroke length/position set કરો.

Drive motor rotationને ram reciprocationમાં ફેરવે.

Cutting strokeમાં tool strip દૂર કરે.

Return સામાન્ય રીતે quicker,idle;correct tool reliefથી dragging ટળે.

Appropriate strokes વચ્ચે incremental table feed next strip આપે.

Safe stop પછી flatness,size,finish inspect કરીને adjustment થાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

આખી ram/table travelથી hands,obstacles દૂર રાખો;automatic return પણ hazardous motion છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Stroke capacity and support geometry determine whether a job fits.

Understand why

Illustrative specification:maximum stroke500mm, table400×300mm, double strokes10–80/min, motor3kW.

State table travel, clearance and available stroke/feed ranges; these sample values are not a measured machine record.

Straight, bent, side-cutting, slotting and form tools serve suitable features with appropriate rake/relief.

Machine vice, T-bolts/clamps, angle plates and fixtures locate work; support thin sections to limit bending.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Stroke capacity,support geometryથી job fit થાય કે નહિ નક્કી થાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Illustrative specification:maximum stroke500mm,table400×300mm,double strokes10–80/min,motor3kW.

Table travel,clearance,stroke/feed ranges લખો;sample values measured machine record નથી.

Straight,bent,side-cutting,slotting,form tools suitable rake/reliefથી features બનાવે.

Machine vice,T-bolts/clamps,angle plate,fixture work locate કરે;thin sectionને bending સામે support આપો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A uniformly rotating crank pin slides in a pivoted lever slot; linkage drives the ram.

Understand why

The crank completes unequal angular sweeps during cutting and return because of the offset pivot geometry.

At uniform crank speed, time is proportional to angle; larger cutting angle gives longer cutting time.

Quick-return ratioK=tcut/treturn=theta cut/theta return>1 in the usual arrangement.

The ratio does not imply a constant ram velocity within each stroke; linkage velocity varies continuously.

Sketch fixed pivots, crank circle, sliding block, slotted lever, connecting link and ram—not just two arrows.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Uniform rotating crank pin pivoted leverની slotમાં slide થાય;linkage ram ચલાવે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Offset pivot geometryથી cutting,return દરમિયાન crankના angular sweeps unequal હોય.

Uniform crank speedમાં time angleના proportional;larger cutting angleથી વધુ cutting time.

Usual arrangementમાં K=tcut/treturn=theta cut/theta return>1.

Ratioથી દરેક strokeમાં constant ram velocity થાય એવું નહિ;velocity સતત બદલાય.

Fixed pivots,crank circle,sliding block,slotted lever,connecting link,ram દોરો;ફક્ત બે arrows નહિ.

h.en: 5.1.5 Whitworth mechanism:do not confuse its members

body.en:
Definition / principle

An offset-centre crank and slotted rotating member produce nonuniform output motion transmitted to the ram.

Understand why

Identify the input crank centre separately from the slotted-member centre.

The crank pin slides relative to the slot as the input rotates uniformly.

The offset geometry changes output angular velocity; the attached linkage converts it into unequal-time strokes.

A crank-and-slotted oscillating lever and a Whitworth arrangement are related quick-return ideas but should not be labelled identical without their actual diagram.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Offset-centre crank,slotted rotating member nonuniform output આપે,જે ram સુધી પહોંચે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Input crank centre,slotted-member centre અલગ ઓળખો.

Input uniformly rotate થાય ત્યારે crank pin slotમાં relative slide થાય.

Offset geometry output angular velocity બદલે;attached linkage unequal-time strokes આપે.

Crank-slotted oscillating lever,Whitworth સંબંધિત quick-return ideas છે,પણ actual diagram વગર identical ન કહો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A valve routes pressurised fluid to alternate cylinder sides; effective area and flow determine speed.

Understand why

Pump, reservoir, directional control, relief protection, cylinder and return lines form the conceptual circuit.

For a single-rod cylinder, the rod-side annular area is less than the full piston area.

With equal volumetric flow, v=Q/A, so the smaller effective return area gives greater return speed in the stated arrangement.

Hydraulic drives can provide smoother controlled cutting speed and overload protection via designed controls; leakage, temperature and maintenance affect performance.

Mechanical mechanisms are positive linkages with geometry-related speed variation; hydraulic speed depends on circuit flow/area and load control.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Valve pressurised fluidને cylinderની alternate sides આપે;effective area,flow speed નક્કી કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Pump,reservoir,directional control,relief protection,cylinder,return lines conceptual circuit બનાવે.

Single-rod cylinderમાં rod-side annular area full piston areaથી ઓછું હોય.

Equal flowમાં v=Q/A;stated arrangementમાં smaller return areaથી વધુ return speed મળે.

Hydraulic drive designed controlsથી smoother speed,overload protection આપે;leakage,temperature,maintenance અસર કરે.

Mechanical linkageમાં geometryથી speed variation;hydraulic speed circuit flow/area,load control પર આધારિત છે.

h.en: 5.1.7 Quick-return timing and mean cutting speed
h.gu: 5.1.7 Quick-return Timing અને Mean Cutting Speed

body.en:
Given and model

Crank cutting angle210degrees, return150degrees,30cycles/min, stroke300mm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. K=210/150=1.4; cycle time=60/30=2s
  2. tcut=2×210/360=1.166667s; treturn=.833333s
  3. Mean cutting speed=.3/(1.166667/60)=15.428571m/min
  4. Mean return speed=.3/(.833333/60)=21.6m/min

Common mistake / conditions

A cycle contains one cutting and one return stroke; do not double the given cycles/min without checking the specification wording.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Cutting angle210degrees,return150degrees,30cycles/min,stroke300mm.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. K=210/150=1.4;cycle time=60/30=2s
  2. tcut=2×210/360=1.166667s;treturn=.833333s
  3. Mean cutting speed=.3/(1.166667/60)=15.428571m/min
  4. Mean return speed=.3/(.833333/60)=21.6m/min

Common Mistake / શરતો

Cycleમાં એક cutting,એક return હોય;specification wording જોયા વગર cycles/min બમણાં ન કરો.

h.en: 5.1.8 Hydraulic area ratio and shaping time
h.gu: 5.1.8 Hydraulic Area Ratio અને Shaping Time

body.en:
Given and model

Equal flow6000cm³/min, cut area80cm², return area50cm².For a separate shaping pass, total cross-feed travel120mm, f.5mm/cycle, N30cycles/min.

Step-by-step solution

  1. vcut=6000/80=75cm/min; vreturn=6000/50=120cm/min
  2. For equal stroke:K=tcut/treturn=120/75=1.6
  3. Shaping cycles=120/.5=240; time=240/30=8min

Common mistake / conditions

Total cross-feed travel is supplied including the planned width allowance; time excludes setup and idle noncycling work.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Equal flow6000cm³/min,cut area80cm²,return area50cm².અલગ shaping passમાં total cross-feed120mm,f.5mm/cycle,N30cycles/min.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. vcut=6000/80=75cm/min;vreturn=6000/50=120cm/min
  2. For equal stroke:K=tcut/treturn=120/75=1.6
  3. Shaping cycles=120/.5=240;time=240/30=8min

Common Mistake / શરતો

Total cross-feedમાં planned width allowance સામેલ છે;timeમાં setup,noncycling idle work નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A large table reciprocates the clamped work under toolheads carried by a strong frame.

Construction:part and purpose

A long bed guides the reciprocating table.

The table carries heavy work on suitable slots/fixtures.

Two housings support a crossrail spanning the work zone.

Crossrail toolheads position cutting edges above the work.

Side toolheads, where fitted, can machine vertical faces.

Table drive provides cutting and idle-return motion; feed drives increment tool positions.

Travel stops, guards, lubrication and heavy-duty workholding support safe movement.

Working:flow and reason

Plan the datum and clamp the large work to the table.

Position the crossrail and toolheads for the required surfaces within capacity.

Table drive moves work past the tool during the cutting stroke.

Suitable single-point edges remove material as the work translates.

The table returns idle with approved tool relief/clearance.

Tool feed increments present the next surface strip.

After safe stopping, inspect planes, parallelism and dimensions.

Common mistake / conditions

Large moving mass and long travel require a protected exclusion zone; multiple toolheads do not remove collision risk.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Strong frameના toolheads નીચે large table clamped workને reciprocate કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Long bed reciprocating table guide કરે.

Table suitable slots/fixtures પર heavy work રાખે.

બે housings work zone ઉપર crossrail support કરે.

Crossrail toolheads work ઉપર cutting edges position કરે.

Fitted side toolheads vertical faces machine કરે.

Table drive cutting,idle-return આપે;feed drive toolsને increment આપે.

Travel stops,guards,lubrication,heavy-duty holding safe movementમાં મદદ કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Datum plan કરીને large work table પર clamp કરો.

Capacityમાં required surfaces માટે crossrail,toolheads position કરો.

Cutting strokeમાં table drive workને tool પાસેથી ખસેડે.

Work translate થાય ત્યારે single-point edges material દૂર કરે.

Approved tool relief/clearance સાથે table idle return કરે.

Tool feed increment next surface strip આપે.

Safe stop પછી planes,parallelism,dimensions inspect કરો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Large moving mass,long travel માટે protected exclusion zone જોઈએ;multiple toolheadsથી collision risk દૂર થતો નથી.

h.en: 5.1.10 Shaper vs planer and common operations
h.gu: 5.1.10 Shaper સામે Planer અને Common Operations

body.en:
Definition / principle

Compare motions, capacity and feed—not just machine size.

Understand why

Shaper:tool reciprocates, work table commonly receives cross-feed. Planer:work/table reciprocates, toolheads receive feed.

Shaper suits smaller work and usually one main tool; planer can support large jobs and multiple heads.

Horizontal, vertical, angular surfaces, steps, slots and suitable profiles can be produced with appropriate tools/feeds.

Interrupted reciprocating production has idle return time; do not assume it matches milling productivity for every feature.

Which machine normally moves the large work back and forth?

The planer; the shaper normally reciprocates the tool.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

ફક્ત size નહિ,motion,capacity,feed compare કરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Shaperમાં tool reciprocate,tableને cross-feed.Planerમાં work/table reciprocate,toolheadsને feed.

Shaper smaller work,સામાન્ય રીતે એક main tool;planer large jobs,multiple heads લે.

Suitable tool/feedથી horizontal,vertical,angular surfaces,steps,slots,profiles બને.

Reciprocating productionમાં idle return time હોય;દરેક feature માટે milling જેવી productivity ન માનો.

Large Workને સામાન્ય રીતે કયું આગળ-પાછળ ચલાવે?

Planer;shaper સામાન્ય રીતે tool reciprocate કરે.

h.en: 5.1.11 Shape flats, angles and slots with a reason
h.gu: 5.1.11 Flat,Angle અને Slotને કારણ સાથે Shape કરો

body.en:
Definition / principle

Cutting direction, toolhead setting and feed direction must match the feature.

Understand why

For a horizontal plane, successive strips cover the work width using controlled cross-feed.

Vertical/angular surfaces require appropriate toolhead orientation and feed, with adequate clearance on return.

Slots and keyways use suitable narrow tools; chip clearance and deflection become important in deep/narrow features.

A profile/form tool can create a selected contour, but broad contact raises load and chatter risk.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Cutting direction,toolhead setting,feed direction feature સાથે match થવાં જોઈએ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Horizontal planeમાં controlled cross-feedથી successive strips width cover કરે.

Vertical/angular surfaceમાં suitable toolhead orientation,feed,return clearance જોઈએ.

Slots/keywaysમાં suitable narrow tool;deep/narrow featureમાં chip clearance,deflection મહત્વનાં.

Profile/form tool contour આપે,પણ broad contactથી load,chatter risk વધે.

h.en: 5.1.12 Why quicker return is not faster cutting
h.gu: 5.1.12 Quicker Return એટલે Faster Cutting નહિ

body.en:
Definition / principle

The return saves noncutting cycle time without necessarily changing the required cutting condition.

Understand why

A shorter return can increase cycles/min at the same mean cutting speed, but acceleration and drive limits still apply.

Comparing two drives needs equal stroke, cutting condition and feed basis; otherwise a time ratio alone is misleading.

Common errors:using total cycle time as cutting time, forgetting mm→m, and confusing strokes/min with double strokes/min.

The ideal mechanism formula ignores machine acceleration, stops and job-specific handling; identify it as a model.

Is K=treturn/tcut in these notes?

No. Here K=tcut/treturn; always state the convention.

Do equal crank angles produce quick return at uniform speed?

Not from angle timing alone. Equal angles give equal times in that model.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Return noncutting cycle time બચાવે;required cutting condition બદલાય તે જરૂરી નહિ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Shorter returnથી same mean cutting speedમાં cycles/min વધી શકે,પણ acceleration,drive limits રહે.

બે drives compare કરવા same stroke,cutting condition,feed basis જોઈએ;ફક્ત time ratio misleading છે.

Common errors:cycle timeને cutting time માનવો,mm→m ભૂલવું,strokes/minને double strokes/min સાથે ભેળવવું.

Ideal formulaમાં acceleration,stops,handling નથી;તે model છે તે જણાવો.

આ Notesમાં K=treturn/tcut છે?

ના.અહીં K=tcut/treturn;convention હંમેશાં લખો.

Uniform Speedમાં Equal Crank Anglesથી Quick Return મળે?

ફક્ત angle timingથી નહિ.તે modelમાં equal anglesથી equal times મળે.
